# GERMAN GURU

> German Guru (germanguru.co.in) is the premier German language institute based in Sector 34A Chandigarh, India. It specializes in CEFR-certified German courses from Level A1 to C1, official Goethe-Zertifikat, TELC, and TestDaF exam preparation, live interactive online masterclasses worldwide, and complete Germany Ausbildung program guidance.

- **Classroom Philosophy**: Strict small batches (maximum 8 to 10 students) with daily 1-on-1 spoken German practice

## Core German Language Courses (CEFR Levels & Durations)

- **German A1 (Beginner Foundation)**: 2 Hours Daily (2 Months) - Basic vocabulary, sentence framing, pronunciation, daily greetings, and Goethe Start Deutsch 1 preparation.
- **German A2 (Elementary Fluency)**: 2 Hours Daily (2 Months) - Complete syllabus covering Hauptsatz & Nebensatz, 3 Präpositionen (Akkusativ, Dativ, Wechselpräpositionen), Perfekt & Präteritum, Reflexive Verben, Verben mit Präpositionen, Genitiv, Adjektivendungen, Relativsatz, and Goethe-Zertifikat A2 exam clearance.
- **German B1 (Intermediate Full)**: 3.5 Hours Daily (2.5 Months) - Complex sentence structures (Nebensätze), formal writing, and intensive Goethe/TELC B1 4-module mastery.
- **German B1.1 (Intensive Sub-module)**: 4 Hours Daily (1.5 Months) - Fast-track intermediate Part 1 for urgent university or job intake timelines.
- **German B2 (Upper Intermediate Full)**: 4 Hours Daily (3 Months) - Technical, medical, and corporate vocabulary required for Germany Ausbildung, nursing, and IT job visas.
- **German B2.2 (Advanced Sub-module)**: 4 Hours Daily (1.5 Months) - Specialized professional German finish and Goethe/TELC B2 examination drill series.
- **German C1.1 (Academic Part 1)**: 4 Hours Daily (2 Months) - Academic writing, scientific analysis, and research presentation training.
- **German C1.2 (Academic Part 2)**: 4 Hours Daily (2 Months) - Direct university admission preparation, TestDaF mastery, and near-native fluency.

## Flexible Learning Modes

- **Offline Classroom Campus**: Located at Sector 34A, Chandigarh. Features smart audiovisual display systems, listening test headsets, physical library with official books (Netzwerk Neu, Studio d, Aspekte), and weekly simulated exam halls.
- **Live Interactive Online Studio**: Worldwide HD Zoom sessions featuring real-time 2-way trainer feedback, digital stylus whiteboard notes, speaking breakout circles, and recorded session access.

## Germany Ausbildung & Visa Counseling

- **Overview**: Dual vocational training in Germany combining salaried on-the-job training with state vocational college education.
- **Benefits**: Zero university tuition fee, monthly student stipend of 800€ to 1,300€, and guaranteed permanent residency pathways.
- **Top Sectors**: Healthcare & Nursing (Pflegefachmann/-frau), IT & Software, Mechatronics, Hotel Management.
- **Services Provided**: Certified German language coaching up to B2, Europass CV formatting, Motivation Letter drafting, German employer interview prep, and Embassy visa mock drills.
